integrity: The operator-limit theorem is proved analytically; finite exact-rational checks supplement but do not certify the infinite-dimensional result. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the unit point-mass, order-two Hardy Hilbert operator is treated; an implicit entire-function root law, not elementary roots or a sharp higher-index root asymptotic, is proved. The full text of the recent motivating manuscript was not completely accessible during the bibliographic comparison; independent publication-priority review has not been performed.
title: A hypergeometric singular-spectrum limit for second-order point-mass Cesàro operators
